# Third-party licenses

<!-- Generated by scripts/license_inventory.py. Do not edit by hand; run `uv run python scripts/license_inventory.py` after changing uv.lock or frontend/package-lock.json. `make check` fails while this file is stale. -->

This inventory lists every third-party package that ships in the Kebivo container image: the runtime Python dependencies resolved in `uv.lock` for Linux CPython, and the npm packages bundled into the admin UI from `frontend/package-lock.json`. Development and test tools are not shipped and are not listed. License identifiers come from the package metadata and are not legal advice.

Kebivo itself is licensed under Apache-2.0 (the `LICENSE` file in the repository root). The compatibility column is checked against Apache-2.0: permissive licenses are marked compatible, and an `OR` expression is compatible when one alternative is.

**Packages flagged for review: 1.**

## Review notes

- **certifi 2026.10.19** (MPL-2.0): File-level copyleft. Kebivo ships the files unmodified, which an Apache-2.0 distribution may include; keep the MPL notice and point to the upstream source. Modified MPL files would have to stay under MPL-2.0.

## Other shipped components

| Component | License | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fonts | None bundled | The UI uses the operating system font stack (`system-ui`). |
| Kebivo mark and favicon (`frontend/public/`) | Project asset | Created for this project; covered by the project license (Apache-2.0). |
| `python:3.12-slim` base image | PSF-2.0 (Python) and Debian package licenses | Not inventoried here; inspect the image with an SBOM tool before redistribution. |
| `uv` binary copied into the image | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Installs the locked dependencies at build time and remains in the image. |
